name: Belote Découverte
description: Belote Découverte (Discovered/Open Belote) is a brilliant 2-player adaptation of the classic French game. It solves the issue of hidden information by dealing cards face up and face down on the table (similar to Schnapsen or German Whist variants), creating a game of perfect information and intense calculation. Players can see many of their opponent's potential moves, making it a chess-like duel of blocking and forcing.

history.origins: A modern adaptation created to allow Belote enthusiasts to play when a full quartet is unavailable.
timeline: Mid-20th Century: Emerges as a tavern filler for waiting players.
1990s: Gains popularity in digital formats as it is easier to implement for 2 players.
Present: Standard 2-player variant in most apps.
history.cultural: Less serious than Coinche, but respected for its analytical depth.
history.evolution: The mechanic of Face-Up/Face-Down piles is borrowed from games like 'Straw' or 'Slovenian Tarock' 2-player variants.

setup.players: Two players only. Belote Découverte is the two-player open-cards variant: each player has a tableau of face-up and face-down cards plus a private hand; play is head-to-head with no partnerships.
setup.dealing: Each player receives 16 cards, but not all in hand. 1. Deal 6 cards to each player FACE DOWN in a row. 2. Deal 6 cards FACE UP on top of the face-down cards. 3. Deal the remaining 4 cards to each player's HAND (concealed).

rules.objective: Score more points than the opponent. Standard Belote scoring applies (162 total).
rules.gameplay: 1. **Trump Selection**: A bidding round occurs to Establish the trump suit. 2. **Play**: Non-dealer leads. 3. **The Cards**: You can play any card from your hand or any face-up card on your tableau. 4. **Uncovering**: When a face-up card is played from the tableau, the face-down card underneath it is immediately turned face up and becomes available for the next trick.
keyRules: Must trump if void in led suit.
Must over-trump if trumps are played.
Face-down cards are blocked until the covering card is played.

strategy.basic: Identify the Trumps on the board. If the Jack is buried face down, try to dig for it. If it's visible on opponent's side, force them to use it on a low card if possible.
strategy.intermediate: Blocking: Don't play a face-up card if it uncovers a card you suspect is useful to the opponent.
strategy.advanced: Card Counting: You know 12+4=16 cards of your own, plus 6 of opponent's = 22 cards visible. Only 10 are hidden. Deducing the opponent's hand is trivial.
tips: Keep high cards in your hand as surprises.
Clear your face-up cards to access the hidden value underneath.

variations.name: Standard 2-Player
variations.description: Standard hand deal (6 cards each), draw pile. Less strategic than Découverte.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: This variant describes standard two-player Belote; detailed engine differences from Découverte are left to future overrides.

scoring.description: Standard Belote ranking/values apply to all captured tricks.
scoring.winCondition: Usually played to 500 or 1000 total points.

synthesis.shortDescription: A chess-like duel for two players. With half the deck visible on the table, you can plan your attack with surgical precision. But beware—every card you play reveals a new threat from the depths of the face-down pile.
